claims.subject: ai-switch-silicon
claims.statement: Broadcom: Tomahawk 6 family (102.4 Tbps) is shipping in production volume; optimized for AI scale-out and scale-up networks targeting clusters with more than one million XPUs.
claims.source_title: Broadcom Shipping Tomahawk 6 in Production Volume

claims.subject: ai-switch-silicon
claims.statement: Broadcom (earnings commentary via syndicated transcript): Tomahawk 6 deployed across nearly all AI hyperscalers building XPUs with Broadcom, and also used by customers not using Broadcom XPUs.
claims.source_title: Broadcom Q3 FY2026 Earnings Call Highlights
claims.notes: Syndicated transcript; treat as company claim pending primary filing.

claims.subject: high-speed-serdes
claims.statement: Tomahawk 6 supports 100G and 200G SerDes; Broadcom claims industry-leading SerDes reach for passive copper interconnect and options for 512×200G or 1024×100G SerDes on a single chip.
claims.source_title: Broadcom Shipping Tomahawk 6 in Production Volume

claims.subject: optical-transceivers
claims.statement: Broadcom: rapid AI workload growth drives demand for increased bandwidth and interconnect density; positions 800G and 1.6T optical transceiver applications as target markets for new DSP PHYs.

claims.subject: optical-transceivers
claims.statement: Broadcom Taurus 400G/lane optical DSP enables low-power 1.6T pluggable modules and a path toward 3.2T designs for AI data centers.

claims.subject: optical-transceivers
claims.statement: Secondary analysis citing McKinsey (June 2025): 800G transceiver production projected 40–60% short of demand through 2027; 1.6T shortfalls 30–40% through 2029.
claims.notes: Secondary reporting of analyst estimate; not Broadcom primary.

claims.subject: optical-dsp
claims.statement: Broadcom Sian3 3nm 200G/lane PAM4 DSP PHY targets 800G and 1.6T modules; claims >20% power reduction vs prior for EML and SiP-based 1.6T modules; production ramp planned Q3 2025.

claims.subject: optical-dsp
claims.statement: Broadcom: Taurus BCM83640 is industry-first 3nm 400G/lane optical PAM4 DSP for 1.6T transceiver solutions with integrated laser driver.

claims.subject: laser-sources
claims.statement: Broadcom: 200G EML in production with millions of units shipped; shipping 200G/lane lasers alongside DSP portfolio for AI optical interconnects.

claims.subject: laser-sources
claims.statement: Broadcom (earnings commentary via syndicated transcript): more than tripling year-over-year capacity at indium phosphide factories for EML, CW laser, and VCSEL products (US and Singapore).
claims.source_title: Broadcom Q3 FY2026 Earnings Call Highlights
claims.notes: Capacity expansion implies prior pressure; syndicated transcript.

claims.subject: laser-sources
claims.statement: Secondary research: Lumentum described as only supplier shipping 200G-per-lane EMLs at volume for 1.6T transceivers; EML production concentrated in precision InP fabs.
claims.notes: Secondary claim of supplier concentration; confidence moderated.

claims.subject: optical-engines
claims.statement: Tomahawk 6 – Davisson integrates sixteen 6.4 Tbps optical engines with the 102.4 Tbps switch ASIC for co-packaged optics.

claims.subject: cpo-integration
claims.statement: Broadcom: TH6-Davisson is third-generation CPO Ethernet switch shipping; claims first 102.4 Tbps optically enabled switching capacity and power-efficiency gains for AI scale-up/scale-out.
claims.notes: Shipping announced; production volume vs sampling not quantified in primary PR.

claims.subject: cpo-integration
claims.statement: NVIDIA announces Spectrum-X Photonics co-packaged optics networking switches for AI factories, indicating multi-vendor CPO push for AI networking.

claims.subject: networking-packaging
claims.statement: Davisson CPO architecture packages switch ASIC with multiple optical engines in one system — implying specialized advanced packaging beyond standard pluggable switch designs.
claims.notes: Packaging implication is structural from product description.

claims.subject: network-power
claims.statement: Broadcom: optical interconnect power is a major factor limiting AI/ML cluster scalability; new DSP generations explicitly target power reduction for 800G/1.6T modules.

claims.subject: network-power
claims.statement: Davisson CPO positioned for major advancements in power efficiency versus prior CPO generations while doubling optically enabled switch bandwidth.

claims.subject: network-thermal
claims.statement: Partner commentary in Broadcom Davisson release: as industry scales 800G today and prepares for 1.6T interconnects, power savings and stability are required for next-generation large-scale AI infrastructure.
claims.notes: Partner quote in Broadcom PR; thermal/power coupling inferred from power density.

claims.subject: high-speed-serdes
claims.statement: Broadcom positions extended copper reach via SerDes as reducing optics count and improving reliability/TCO for AI clusters — implying SerDes performance shapes copper-vs-optics boundary.
claims.source_title: Broadcom Shipping Tomahawk 6 in Production Volume

claims.subject: cpo-integration
claims.statement: Davisson uses external lasers with co-packaged optical engines — laser supply remains an external dependency even when optics are packaged with the switch.
claims.notes: External laser architecture noted in product descriptions / industry coverage of Davisson; confirm via primary product materials.
